entry.use_when: see which works a paper invokes, for which propositions, and with what kind of engagement
entry.fit_note: Requires a text with references; source fidelity needs the cited work itself.

entry.use_when: identify whose values support the judgments and which priorities or tradeoffs the text actually states
entry.row_unit: one row per value-backed judgment or tradeoff
entry.fit_note: Distinguishes the author’s values from quoted or criticized positions.

entry.use_when: follow what a central idea is said to cause, what produces it and how the proposed mechanism works
entry.yields: causal-role inventory with conditions and intervention status
entry.row_unit: one row per attributed causal relation
entry.fit_note: Maps the paper’s causal claims; does not independently establish causal effects.

entry.use_when: preserve if-then relations, necessary conditions and nested exceptions when using a paper’s claims
entry.row_unit: one row per implication or qualification
entry.fit_note: Distinguishes stated conditions from the reader’s reconstruction.

entry.use_when: find an order for understanding a difficult paper, with prerequisites, useful passages and possible misreadings
entry.yields: proposed reading sequence and learning-aid table
entry.row_unit: one row per learning step or corrective passage
entry.fit_note: A general route; tailoring requires the reader’s starting knowledge.

entry.use_when: understand how a paper’s appeals, contrasts and style work together to invite agreement
entry.yields: persuasive reading with appeals and interaction tables
entry.row_unit: one row per persuasive move or interaction
entry.fit_note: Describes textual invitations; actual audience effects need reception evidence.

entry.use_when: test which explanations the supplied evidence distinguishes and where alternatives remain open
entry.yields: hypothesis and diagnostic-evidence tables with a bounded reading
entry.row_unit: one row per explanation or evidence comparison
entry.fit_note: Needs an explanatory question and reported evidence; no unsupported probability ranking.

entry.use_when: understand the documented conflict between individual actions and a proposed shared outcome
entry.row_unit: one row per cooperation mechanism or response
entry.fit_note: Requires evidence of actors, interests and the shared or disputed outcome.

entry.use_when: see how the source’s choice of boundaries changes what it counts and who bears consequences
entry.row_unit: one row per boundary or changed consequence
entry.fit_note: Alternative boundaries are labeled proposals; missing mention alone does not prove exclusion.

entry.use_when: inventory how people, organizations, artifacts and documents combine into a working arrangement
entry.row_unit: one row per component role or supported link
entry.fit_note: Requires an account of an actual or proposed arrangement; does not invent technical workings.

entry.use_when: track reported deals, dates, amounts, status and the rights or holdings that change
entry.row_unit: one row per transaction or rights change
entry.fit_note: Uses dated transaction reporting; announcements and completed transfers remain distinct.

entry.use_when: follow reported accumulations and feedback paths, keeping unsupported return links and rates open
entry.row_unit: one row per stock, flow, link or supported path
entry.fit_note: A qualitative map of the supplied account; numerical rates require measurements.
